Several sites in this batch share a stray horse emoji in page titles (Frazer, De Loughy, Bernales, Basily, Nahum, Expedient, SAI, Nisonoff), which suggests a common template or SEO plugin artifact - inference, not confirmed.

Phone-width checks were done at 390px using Chrome device emulation; pages that do not declare a responsive layout render at a fixed desktop width, which is what produced the 'broken' ratings for Bernales and Nahum.
Withum was excluded as a large multi-office firm; it remains 'operating' but is not a realistic client for a one-person consultancy.
No forms were submitted and no phone numbers were called, so response times and form behaviour are unverified.
data_gaps: Review counts and claimed/unclaimed status could not be confirmed for most Google profiles.
De Loughy & Associates: no Google listing surfaced; a profile may exist under a variant name.
U.S. Eagle Financial Center: no East Brunswick Google listing found; the only related profile is 'U.S. Eagle Tax' in Freehold, which may be a different or successor entity - unconfirmed.
Bernales & Associates: Google profile found is at 440 W Union Ave, Bound Brook, not the East Brunswick address in the batch.
Robert P. Nahum: no office hours appear anywhere on the site.
Withum was excluded after light checks, so its website and profile were not audited.
Career.com job page for U.S. Eagle could not be opened (fetch failed); the job title came from the search result snippet.
